verdict.rationale: The xAI docs say some models accept images as input and use them when generating a response, and image editing is described as understanding source-image content. That covers the core of photo and screenshot interpretation, but only as a brief, model-limited API note. Missing for 10: evidence of screenshot/photo upload in the Grok consumer app for knowledge-workers, detail on which models support image input, and independent or hands-on corroboration of interpretation accuracy.
